glossary.HIPAA: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act — federal law requiring safeguards for protected health information (PHI)
glossary.HITECH: Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act — strengthens HIPAA enforcement and breach notification
glossary.PHI: Protected Health Information — individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity
glossary.BAA: Business Associate Agreement — contract requiring vendors who handle PHI to comply with HIPAA
glossary.OCR: Office for Civil Rights — the HHS division that enforces HIPAA
